description: Phase 1 (2026-05-23 follow-up) regression guard for the video texture slot leak fix. Before the fix, allocating a VideoTexture slot via ImportVideo and then deleting the clip left the slot permanently allocated until process exit (no on_destroy<VideoTexture> observer was wired). The fix adds a deferred-free observer: the editor thread's on_destroy fires and enqueues the slot; the show thread drains at beginShowFrame behind the #89 gate protocol (editor gate mayMutate + retire-fence witnesses), so the free needs a few show ticks of real GPU progress, not just one drain pass. The settle wait is sized for loaded-WARP CI where fences can lag. This test verifies: (1) importing a clip allocates a slot, (2) deleting the clip schedules its release, (3) after giving the drain time to settle, the slot count returns to zero.
